title: Motorboatin' Joes Erase Early Deficit, Hold Off King Cobras 5-3
description:
Globo Gym King Cobras D vs. Motorboatin' Joes D — Game #7718
Final Score: Motorboatin' Joes 5 – King Cobras 3
Date: 07/15/26 • League: BH Adult D • Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 1
Period by Period: King Cobras 1-1-1 (3) | Motorboatin' Joes 0-3-2 (5)

King Cobras opened the scoring, but Motorboatin' Joes ripped off three straight in the second, and after King Cobras clawed within one in the third, Jonathan Baxter's second goal of the night restored the two-goal cushion for good.

📝 Game Notes
Motorboatin' Joes never trailed after Leitch's opening goal wore off, riding a three-goal second period to build the cushion they needed. King Cobras' push, a goal from Jennings right at the second-period buzzer and another from Albano early in the third, got them within one, but Baxter's second goal shut the door. King Cobras took both penalties called; the Joes stayed out of the box all night.
